units.text: Metal-organic frameworks were the subject of the 2025 Nobel Chemistry Prize announced in Stockholm, Sweden. Official Nobel announcement states MOFs were the awarded topic; the prize was awarded at the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences in Stockholm, Sweden, on 8 October 2025.

judgement.reason: The passages confirm the 2025 Nobel Prize in Chemistry was awarded for metal-organic frameworks and announced at the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences in Stockholm, Sweden, but they do not mention the date 8 October 2025.

units.text: The 2025 Nobel Prize in Chemistry was awarded to Susumu Kitagawa, Richard Robson, and Omar M. Yaghi for their pioneering work in metal-organic frameworks (MOFs), confirming MOFs as the prize subject.

citations.title: Susumu Kitagawa, Richard Robson and Omar Yaghi win 2025 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for metal organic frameworks

judgement.reason: The passage states that the 2025 Nobel Prize in Chemistry was awarded to Kitagawa, Robson, and Yaghi for their pioneering work in the development of metal-organic frameworks (MOFs), directly supporting the statement.

units.text: The announcement location was Stockholm, Sweden, as confirmed by the Nobel Prize press release stating the prize was announced at the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences in Stockholm, Sweden.
